fillerEvidence.architecture: content_filler -> resolve_balancer(Collaps then Zona) -> optional torrent fallback; LazyMedia provider registry is not used

rootCauses.evidence: 671/1000 random cards have zero validated streams; top-1000 control has 960/1000

rootCauses.issue: background filler bypasses LazyMedia provider architecture
rootCauses.evidence: content_filler uses Collaps/Zona/torrent path, not the 3.466 provider registry/variant tree
recent logs repeatedly stop on metered_default and quota_probe_failed
316/329 streamful random cards are P2P-only; only 13/1000 have any HTTP stream

rootCauses.issue: series inventory is stored at card level without exact episode identity
rootCauses.evidence: 45/53 streamful sampled TV cards have streams but no season+episode tags
YTS supplies quality but no voice diversity; Collaps supplies voices but quality mostly Auto

rootCauses.issue: Android menu is downstream of candidate inventory and cannot create missing provider variants
rootCauses.evidence: menus are built from PlaybackSession.candidates/streamOptions; UI-only change cannot recover absent provider variants

repairPlan: Make one ProviderRegistry/VariantTree service the only discovery/enrichment source of truth.
Port active LazyMedia 3.466 provider adapters into backend clean-room contract, starting with Filmix then other cleanly recovered active providers; keep Zona adapters as second family.
Use the same provider service for user-triggered playback and background enrichment; remove separate resolve_balancer-only architecture.
User-triggered discovery must never be blocked by background metered/quota policy; quota guards apply only to bulk prefetch.
Cache structured variants by exact identity: movie contentId, or series contentId+season+episode. Never treat untagged card-level series streams as episode inventory.
Return provider results incrementally and cache them; do not require 96k titles to be fully prefilled before playback works.
Represent available choices as a compatibility graph of source/voice/quality/track so UI only offers combinations that exist.
Preserve adaptive Media3 track qualities only within the same logical stream; do not cross-combine them with unrelated provider voices.
Add deterministic 1000-title regression audit as a gate, split movie/series and popular/long-tail cohorts.
Differential-test each migrated LazyMedia provider against pinned 3.466 fixtures before removing the Dex fallback.

proposedAcceptance.random1000AnyPlayableTarget: >=80% of released/eligible titles after excluding future/unreleased/non-video catalog noise
